factual_claims.source_evidence: Loans to customers amounted to ISK 223.3 bn. ... increasing by ISK 15.8 bn., or 7.6%, from year-end 2025 ... Deposits amounted to ISK 201.2 bn. ... increasing by 16.5% from year-end 2025

factual_claims.claim: Credit quality remained strong, with impairment levels at 1.2% of gross loans.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Overall impairment levels remain low and stable at 1.2% of the gross loan book

factual_claims.claim: Capital and liquidity remained well above requirements: CAR was 23.0%, LCR 276% and NSFR 137%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CAR of 23.0% ... LCR remains strong at 276% ... NSFR stood at 137%

factual_claims.claim: Strategically, Kvika continued to grow lending, improve efficiency and optimise funding.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Progressing Strategic Initiatives ... Loan book growth ... Cost efficiencies ... Improvement in funding costs

factual_claims.claim: The sale process for Straumur greiðslumiðlun was underway, the sale of the UK business’s largest principal investment was progressing, and CEO Ármann Þorvaldsson announced plans to step down by year-end 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sale of Straumur greiðslumiðlun hf. in progress ... CEO Ármann Þorvaldsson to step down by year-end 2026 ... UK segment: sale process for Kvika´s largest principal investment ... expected to close before end of year

numerical_claims.claim: Pre-tax profit of ISK 1,545 million in Q2 2026, down ISK 480 million, or 23.7%, from Q2 2025 and 14.6% from Q1 2026
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Pre-tax profit ISK 1,545 m. vs 2,025 m. (Q2 2025); decrease of 480 m ISK (23.7%); decrease of 264 m ISK from Q1 2026 (14.6%)

numerical_claims.claim: After-tax profit was ISK 903 million, compared with ISK 1,439 million a year earlier and ISK 1,374 million in the previous quarter
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Net operating income decreased 7.3% year on year to ISK 4,756 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net operating income 4,756 m. (Q2 2026) vs 5,128 m. (Q2 2025) = 7.3% decrease

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income remained resilient, increasing 1.7% year on year to ISK 3,013 million, although it fell ISK 253 million from Q1
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest income 3,013 m. (Q2 2026) vs 2,962 m. (Q2 2025) = 1.7% increase; vs 3,266 m. (Q1 2026) = 253 m decrease

numerical_claims.claim: Decline in net interest income primarily due to lower inflation, ISK 10.2 billion dividend payment, and recent issuances
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Impact of the ISK 10.2 bn. dividend payment in June and recent senior preferred and AT1 issuances

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest margin declined to 4.0% from 4.5% in Q1
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest margin was 4.0% in the quarter, compared with 4.5% in Q1 2026

numerical_claims.claim: Net fee and commission income fell 26.8% year on year to ISK 1,416 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net fee and commission income 1,416 m. (Q2 2026) vs 1,935 m. (Q2 2025) = 26.8% decrease

numerical_claims.claim: Other net operating income increased ISK 96 million to ISK 327 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Other net operating income 327 m. (Q2 2026) vs 231 m. (Q2 2025) = 96 m increase

numerical_claims.claim: Administrative expenses decreased 1.1% year on year to ISK 2,947 million despite a one-off ISK 112 million restructuring charge
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Administrative expenses 2,947 m. (Q2 2026) vs 2,981 m. (Q2 2025) = 1.1% decrease; included ISK 112 m. restructuring charge

numerical_claims.claim: Efficiency measures reduced employee count to 232 and target annual cost savings of ISK 300-400 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Efficiency measures ... expected to lower the annual cost base by ISK 300-400 m.

numerical_claims.claim: Net impairment rose to ISK 269 million from ISK 122 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
